The '''DS-4''' was a model of [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] produced by [[Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation/Legends|Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Desler DS-4 was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in update 3.3.1 on [[September 1]], [[2015]] as one of the items in the Wild Space Explorer's Pack on the Cartel Market.
